methodology: Targeted manufacturing-facility expansion using current official company, investor-relations, economic-development, and public location sources. A record qualifies for the narrow Manufacturing facilities category only when a specific Virginia site is publicly documented as performing production, assembly, fabrication, or component manufacturing. Headquarters, research centers, development hangars, and generic company-wide manufacturing claims are excluded unless a source ties manufacturing to the mapped site. Supporting facilities are labeled separately when their output enables unmanned systems but the production line is not dedicated to UxS.
